_note: SAME PROBE AS media-fullpage-library, WITH AN EMPTY LIBRARY — the fixture
answers `getAssets` with nothing and everything else identically, so this
is the same manager in a different state rather than a second fixture that
could drift from the first. The wait names the CTA row, not the manager:
the empty state is what distinguishes this board from 1159:4593 and a wait
on `mgr-root` would resolve for either. The folders and tags the rail
shows are real — an empty library can still have folders — which is what
the board draws too.
BOARD WON — the empty state, and it was the loudest thing on the screen:
1162:4851  the hero is TOP-anchored at a 180 inset with a 10 gap. It was
vertically centred in a 760 column, so at any window height
the CTA moved and never sat where the board puts it.
1162:4852  the icon is a 28px glyph in --color/ink-placeholder. It
shipped as an 80px tinted disc — the largest element on the
screen, weighting the absence rather than the way out of it.
1162:4853  the headline is 14/600, not 16/700.
1162:4854  the sentence is 11, not 13.
BOARD WON — the toolbar buttons, which this board and 1159:4593 draw
identically (1162:4648/4650/4652): 12/6 padding at 12px on a 6 radius.
They shipped on a FIXED 27 height at 13px, and the fixed height is why the
board's 6 vertical pad had never been applied — a set height and a padding
are different properties, so nothing conflicted and nothing won. Same
class of defect as the replace-across footer and the picker's view toggle,
three surfaces apart.
NOT JOINED: 1162:4784, the details rail — see the media-fullpage-library
note; the board draws a flat 14-inset column and AssetDetailsPanel is a
head-over-preview-over-tabs structure, which is a rebuild rather than a
restyle. 1162:4860 is that rail's own empty line, whose --bk-ink-disabled
measured 1.47:1 on white and is --bk-ink-soft now — the board names
ink-placeholder (2.5:1), which also fails, so neither the board nor the
code got this right and the code is now the safer of the two. 1162:4683 is
the rail gap at w-216 (the 1px-border arithmetic). 1162:4645 is the search
field, authority=open:input-fill. The topbar (1162:4618) and rail belong
to other surfaces and are not mounted here.

1162:4685/4686 (the TAGS group) is drawn on this board and does not render: `allTags` is derived from the assets' own tags, so an empty library has no tags to filter by. That is the code contract answering a board that carried the populated state's rail across unchanged — behaviour wins, and a TAGS heading over nothing would be a filter that can only ever return zero. The pills ARE conformed and are measured on media-fullpage-library.
